# 520. Detect Capital

## Solution 1 (time O(n), space O(1))

```python
class Solution(object):
    def detectCapitalUse(self, word):
        """
        :type word: str
        :rtype: bool
        """
        return word.isupper() or word.islower() or (word[0].isupper() and word[1:].islower())
```
